headline: Assistant Professor
about: I study how the Internet is built, governed, and used. My work examines Internet infrastructure and the institutions and processes that shape it, the architecture and governance of online platforms (e.g., decentralisation, content moderation, and online harms), and social behaviour through online activity. I use Internet measurement and computational methods such as natural language processing, machine learning, and network analysis. I co-chair the IRTF Research and Analysis of Standard-Setting Processes Research Group (RASP RG).
